sections.section: Practice portal setup metrics (users, clients, roles, templates, capacity, XPM)
sections.note: Single tool returns ALL sections in one call - UsersCount, UsersActiveCount, UsersAdminCount, UsersWithNoViewsCount, ClientsCount, ClientsMissingPayrollCount, ClientsDisconnectedCount, ConnectRolesCount, ClientRolesSetCount, ClientsMissingDefaultUnassignedRole, TemplatesCount, TemplatesNoScheduleCount, WorkMissingDueDateCount, WorkMissingProcessTagCount, WorkNoClientCount, UsersWithNoCapacitySetupCount, ClientsNotMappedToXpmCount, ProcessTagsNotMappedToXpmCount. Verified live: 8 users (8 admin, 7 no views), 3 clients (2 missing payroll, 1 disconnected), 35 templates (29 no schedule), 129 work items missing due dates.

Optional supplementary tool for per-client connection metadata (hasPayroll, hasPayrollAccess, xpmClientMapping, tenantToKeyPayConnection). Not strictly needed - main tool already returns the named lists.

rationale: Dedicated single-call tool returns every section in the agent's framework with detail lists for drill-down. Live invoke on connect 11374 confirmed all fields populated with realistic counts.

sections.section: Organisation context (country, company type, FY end)
sections.note: Returns countryCode, organisation type, FYEnd day/month. Live on 11668 returned GB/COMPANY/31-March - agent would correctly skip Div7A (Australian only).

Returns AccountClassification + AccountName + Amount. Verified live for client 11668: 17 accounts including Owner A Funds Introduced, Retained Earnings, Accounts Payable - the kind of names Div7A scan targets.
Returns debit/credit/ytdDebit/ytdCredit per account with balanced check. Verified live: 13 accounts, totals balanced.

sections.section: Profit and loss for interest income/expense
sections.note: Same consolidated tool serves all three primary statements.

rationale: Every named data section maps cleanly to Data_FinancialStatements + Data_OrganisationSettings. Country-gating logic (AU only) is supported. Agent can scan for shareholder loan / director loan / drawings / UPE account names without a dedicated tool.

sections.note: Returns countryCode (AU/NZ/GB) so agent applies the right jurisdiction rules.
status filter accepts Active/Disposed/Draft/Registered. Verified live for 11668: 2 DRAFT assets returned (Coffee table, Laptop) with assetNumber, status, purchaseDate, purchasePrice, bookValue.

sections.section: Asset register summary (depreciation totals, by-status counts)
sections.note: Returns by-status counts, top-10 asset types by book value, depreciation totals, disposals activity.
Returns full depreciation history and asset-type settings per asset id (up to 25 ids).
Verified live: Computer Equipment 1583.33, Office Equipment 1000.00. Agent can reconcile register totals to GL.

sections.section: P&L for capital vs revenue scan
sections.note: Agent scans for large one-off purchases miscategorised as repairs/maintenance.

rationale: Complete tool coverage for every framework step. Draft asset detection, register-vs-GL reconciliation, depreciation history, jurisdiction-aware capital vs revenue scan all supported.

sections.note: Returns countryCode and salesTaxBasis (ACCRUAL/CASH).

sections.section: Reconciliation status per bank account (counts, balances, last-reconciled)
sections.note: Tool responds correctly with NO_DATA + recommendation when no bank accounts connected. Live on 11668 returned 'No reconciliation data found for this client'. Schema includes reconciled vs unreconciled counts.
Supports reconciled=false filter + date-range. Agent must compute age buckets client-side. No native bucketing tool.
view=transactions (default) or statementLines. Useful for staleness aggregation.
No dedicated duplicate-detection tool. Fabric_CheckForDuplicateBankTransaction is a write-side guard, not a discovery scan. Agent would need to load all unreconciled txns and dedupe client-side.
No ledger-side matching engine exposed. Agent would have to fetch bills/invoices/journals separately and pair them manually.
Returns score and component metrics.

rationale: Status + unreconciled-list + data-quality flows are all covered, but the two value-add sections (duplicate scan, proposed matches) have NO native tools - the agent must do heavy client-side reasoning over raw bank-transaction rows. Output remains useful but the 'match-batch for one-click approval' promise overreaches the available data.
recommendation: trim-instructions-or-add-tools (drop the match-proposal section OR add Validation_BankReconciliation + a duplicate-scan tool)

sections.note: Drives AU STP Phase 2 vs NZ Payday vs GB RTI branching.

grossWages, totalTax, totalSuper, netPay per payslip; Get returns detail items + super lines.

sections.section: Payroll vs GL reconciliation (wages payable, PAYG, super)
sections.note: No dedicated Validation_PayrollReconciliation tool registered (canonical-241 lists it but local MCP returns TOOL_NOT_FOUND). Agent must manually compare Data_PayRuns_Summary totals to Data_FinancialStatements balance-sheet liability accounts.
Returns settings, pay calendars, pay runs, leave balances. Verified live for 11668: NO_DATA (no payroll).
Validation_SuperReconciliation in canonical list but not registered. Workaround: Data_PayRuns_Summary view=superTotals + balance sheet super liability account.

sections.section: Control account balances on balance sheet
sections.note: Agent can read Wages Payable, PAYG/PAYE Liability, Super Liability balances.

rationale: Core data tools all work. The two Validation_* reconciliation helpers the agent would prefer are not registered, but the agent can complete every section by combining pay-run summaries with balance-sheet reads. STP/RTI/Payday-filing rule logic is prompt-driven, not tool-driven.
recommendation: keep-as-is (consider registering Validation_PayrollReconciliation + Validation_SuperReconciliation to remove manual reconciliation effort)
